candidate_evidence.quote: Participants receive cysteine/methionine deprivation (CMD) diet for 2 days.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The CMD diet will be implemented simultaneously in 2 cohorts of participants with recurrent glioma.

coder_notes: Dietary intervention only (excluded intervention type, not a drug), so no agents listed. Glutathione metabolite levels (blood, urine, MR spectroscopy, resected tumour) are metabolic endpoints of a diet and are not linked to a candidate agent, so target engagement is no and no molecular biomarkers recorded. Cohort B receives radiotherapy only as standard of care.
